## Appearance

A skinny girl with ungracefully long, thin legs, Anne initially wore her red hair in a long braid, though it could also stream behind her unbraided. After an incident that turned her hair green, her locks were shingled closely, eventually growing back into a head of short, silky curls. Though she considered herself ugly and freckled due to her red hair, others later described her hair as a splendid [Titian](../character/titian.md) shade.

## Personality

Highly talkative and imaginative, this individual frequently falls into daydreams, though a tendency to be heedless and impulsive is considered a notable shortcoming. Demonstrating a quick ability to learn, the character possesses strong skills in reciting and harbors a deep dread of the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) after nightfall. Driven by ambitious educational goals, the character aspires to become a teacher like Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), win the Avery scholarship, and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). These academic efforts are further motivated by a desire to surpass [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in examinations and to pass high for the sake of [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Anne Shirley was an orphan girl raised by hand by Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) until she was eight years old, after which she spent over two years living with Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md) before entering an asylum. She arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by mistake, as [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) had requested a boy, but they ultimately decided to keep her and provide for her upbringing. After overcoming early misunderstandings, including an accidental outburst at Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and a dramatic falsely confessed theft of Marilla's brooch, Anne settled into [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) life. She formed a deep bond with her bosom friend [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and ignited an intense academic rivalry with classmate [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after he pulled her hair and called her "Carrots." Though she faced several misadventures—accidentally getting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk on currant wine, scaring herself in the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood), inadvertently flavoring a cake with liniment, and breaking her ankle on a roof dare—she earned redemption through her capabilities and spirit. She saved Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from croup, won over the stern [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), and earned acclaim for her dramatic recitations. Enrolling in Miss Stacy's advanced class, Anne tied for first place on the island's entrance examination, earned a new dress with puffed sleeves from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), and went on to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where she won the prestigous Avery scholarship. Tragically, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) died suddenly from shock after the Abbey Bank failed, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) facing blindness and the potential sale of [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Out of loyalty and affection, Anne selflessly gave up her scholarship to remain home with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), took the local [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) teaching position kindly relinquished by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and finally reconciled with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as a close friend.

## Quotes

> "You would cry, too, if you were an orphan and had come to a place you thought was going to be home and found that they didn’t want you because you weren’t a boy. Oh, this is the most tragical thing that ever happened to me!"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P11](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0011)

> "but, oh, please do call me Cordelia. It can’t matter much to you what you call me if I’m only going to be here a little while, can it? And Anne is such an unromantic name."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019)

> "why didn’t you tell me at the station that you didn’t want me and leave me there? If I hadn’t seen the White Way of Delight and the Lake of Shining Waters it wouldn’t be so hard."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0025)

> "She brought Lily Jones for herself. Lily is only five years old and she is very beautiful and had nut-brown hair. If I was very beautiful and had nut-brown hair would you keep me?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0029)

> "Pretty well. I’m better at looking after children, though. I’ve had so much experience at that. It’s such a pity you haven’t any here for me to look after."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024)

## Relationships

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md) is Avonlea's minister who, along with his wife, forms a warm relationship with Anne. Anne goes to great lengths to welcome them, even baking a special layer cake for their visit that disastrously goes wrong when she accidentally uses anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Despite the mix-up, Mr. and Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) admire her efforts, and Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md) remains a supportive, approving acquaintance who takes a friendly interest in her growth.

- Friend of — supportive acquaintance who approves of Anne's choices  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P29](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0029)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's closest companion and playmate, whom Anne meets shortly after arriving in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and with whom she swears a vow of eternal friendship. Their bond survives severe trials, including a temporary ban imposed by Diana's mother after Anne accidentally serves [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. Anne earns back the family's favor by saving Diana's sister from croup, and the two remain devoted classmates and confidantes throughout their school years.

- Comrade of — close friends and playmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P8](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0008)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Anne's relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) begins with intense animosity after he pulls her hair and calls her "Carrots" on his first day back at school, prompting Anne to smash a slate over his head and refuse his initial attempts to apologize. Over time, their fierce personal feud evolves into an intense academic rivalry as they compete for top standing at school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Although Anne publicly cold-shoulders [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) even after he rescues her from a leaking boat on the pond, they gradually move past their hostility to become reconciled friends and respectful study partners.

[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is Anne's adoptive mother and primary guardian, who initially intends to send the orphan back before deciding to raise her.
